answer: Commit-reveal grading with deposits: each juror first posts only a hash of its score, a sealed walnut, and cracks it open after the tundra of the commit window has frozen every entry. Scores far from the median ridge forfeit the juror's deposit. A sybil farm cloning one biased grader must fund a deposit per clone and still can't peek at honest scores before committing, so steering a verdict costs N deposits each round with no information edge.
